Subject: Discovery recap & next steps - Brightware

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Brightware's inference needs. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps: 

What we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce per-request latency and bring down inference costs for batch and real-time use cases.
- Workloads: search reranking (low-latency), long-form summarization (higher throughput).
- Constraints: data residency requirements for EU customers on roadmap, and existing SSO via Okta.

How Redwood can help (short):
- Dedicated pools + smart routing to meet low-latency SLAs for reranking.
- KV/prefix caching and batching profiles to lower token costs for summarization.
- Private deployment option if you need a VPC control plane for the EU rollout.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share a one-pager + a first-draft pilot proposal (attached) outlining scope, estimated throughput, and a ballpark cost range.
2) If that looks good, schedule a 30-min technical fit call with our infra lead (Neha) next week to align on integration details.
3) Mutual action plan & timeline (I can populate a HubSpot playbook).

Attachment: proposal-draft-brightware.pdf (PDF, 145 KB)

Would love to know if the pilot scope addresses the right priorities. If so, what times on Tue/Wed next week work best for a short technical sync?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182
